agenda_text:
Lancaster Criminal Justice Commission Meeting
44933 Fern Avenue, Lancaster, CA 93534
Chairman David Vierra, Commissioner Mark Brown;
Commissioner Sheldon Carter; Commissioner Jeff Little;
Commissioner Lee Smith, Commissioner Angela Underwood-Jacobs
Commissioner Christy Valaskantjis
LANCASTER CRIMINAL JUSTICE COMMISSION
AGENDA
Wednesday
June 9, 2010
10:00 a.m.
Council Chambers - Lancaster City Hall
Posted by 05:00 p.m. on Monday, November 30, -1
at the entrance to the Lancaster City Hall Council Chambers
CALL TO ORDER
OATH OF OFFICE
Deputy City Clerk to administer Oath of Office to Commissioner Fuller
ROLL CALL
Commission Members: Brown, Fuller, Gaupel, Harris; Vice Chairman Smith; Chairman Vierra
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION
Elder Richard Davis, New Life Community Church of the Apostolic Faith
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation for former Criminal Justice Commission Members
Presenter: Chairman Vierra
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR
This is the time for citizens who would like to address the Criminal Justice Commission on any agendized item. Please complete a speaker card and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
CONSENT CALENDAR
CC 1. Approval of Minutes - March 10, 2010
CC 2. Approval of Minutes - May 12, 2010
CONTINUED BUSINESS
CB 1. Discussion/Determination of Criminal Justice Commission Goals
COMMISSION/ STAFF PRESENTATIONS, UPDATES, REPORTS
1.
Non-Revocable Parole Presentation/Update Presenters: Lt. Downton and Commissioner Gaupel
2.
California Highway Patrol Update Presenter: CHP Captain Hoose
3.
Monthly Crime Statistics Presenter: Jim Kobolt, Sr. Criminal Justice Analyst
4.
Arrest Statistics Presenter: Sergeant Kroeger
5.
Report on Neighborhood Impact Program Presenter: Concepción Harris
6.
Public Safety Budget Update Presenter: Mark Bozigian, City Manager
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR
This portion of the agenda allows an individual the opportunity to address the Criminal Justice Commission on any item NOT ON THE AGENDA. State law prohibits the Commission from taking action on items not on the agenda and your matter will be referred to staff. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
COMMISSIONER COMMENTS
ADJOURNMENT
AGENDA ADDENDUM INFORMATION
On occasion items may be added after the agenda has been mailed to subscribers. Copies of the agenda addendum item will be available at the City Clerk Department and are posted with the agenda on the windows of the City Council Chambers. For more information, please call the City Clerk Department at (661) 723-6020.
All documents available for public review are on file with the City Clerk Department.
